newsitem.title: USA: Xechem International delisted from NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Xechem International delisted from NASDAQ.

text.p: Xechem International Inc said Wednesday that its stock and warrants had been delisted from the Nasdaq Small Cap Market effective at the close of the business day, Feb 4.
The company said that beginning Feb 5 the stock and warrants wil be traded on the OTC Bulletin Board or in the over-the-counter market pink sheets.
The company is investigating the possibility of obtaining a listing on a regional stock exchange, it said, and may also appeal Nasdaq'a decision to delist its shares.
